Overview.Name: D. Harika
Overview.Food_Habit: I lose control if I start eating
Overview.Preference_Notes: Balanced – include non-veg but not in every meal

Meal_1 (Main Meal): Option 1: Cooked rice (1 cup cooked ~150 g) & chicken curry (120 g) & vegetable curry + curd
Option 2: Cooked rice (1 cup cooked ~150 g) & egg curry (2–3 eggs) & vegetable curry
Option 3: Cooked rice (1 cup cooked ~150 g) & paneer curry (100 g) & vegetable curry
Meal_2 (Dinner - lighter): Option 1: Curd (200 g) & cucumber salad + any 1 fruit
Option 2: Cooked rice (1 cup ~150 g) & egg omelette (2 eggs)
Option 3: Cooked rice (1 cup ~150 g) & vegetable curry & curd

Notes_and_Tips: For PCOS, start meals with protein like eggs or chicken before eating rice.
Avoid fried foods as they worsen hormonal imbalance.
For stress eating, pause for 10 minutes after starting a meal before eating more.
Keep dinner lighter to support hormone balance and fat loss.
Consistency in meals and routine will improve energy and reduce cravings.
